abstract: Covers RFC 9421 HTTP Message Signatures: covered components (HTTP fields with the sf, key, bs, req and tr parameters, and the derived components @method, @target-uri, @authority, @scheme, @request-target, @path, @query, @query-param and @status), the signature base and @signature-params, the Signature-Input, Signature and Accept-Signature fields, the created, expires, nonce, alg, keyid and tag parameters, the six registered algorithms and JWS algorithms, verification, and the security and privacy considerations. Also covers RFC 9530 Digest Fields (Content-Digest, Repr-Digest, Want-Content-Digest, Want-Repr-Digest and the hash algorithm registry) as a separate family. RFC 9421 and RFC 9530 are the current lines; draft-cavage-http-signatures-12 and RFC 3230 are legacy, with upgrade checklists. SKILL.md holds the invariants and workflow; references split out versions and upgrades, components and the signature base, signing and verifying with security, algorithms and keys, and digest fields.
